name: Chambéry Savoie Mont Blanc (Chambéry-Aix-les-Bains)

runway.v: one paved runway, 18/36, 2,020 m long and 45 m wide (plus a 700 m grass strip)

slots.v: IATA Level 2; operators ask their handling agent to request slots from COHOR; for IFR general and business aviation a prior request is required
slots.quote: Aircraft operators contact their handling agent who is in charge to request airport slots to COHOR.

notes: All AIP facts from AIP France AD 2 LFLB (AIRAC AMDT 04/25, 17 APR 2025) as republished by DIRCAM; the current SIA edition could not be opened, so changes since April 2025 are possible. ATS hours are in UTC; the French AIP convention is one hour earlier in summer, giving 08:00-21:00 local, but that convention line was not quoted for this page. No explicit night closure is stated. Stands are limited by wingspan and length (largest stands Z1/Z3: 21 m by 30 m), not by weight. COHOR facilitation applies mid-December to mid-April (winter season). Facts from the superseded edition other than runway, location and operator were not used (customs, handling, hours, ppr, notable).
